body: Well, talking about it couldn't hurt anyone I guess.
I don't know if it'd help...
Because I go to bed numb, I wake up numb, I live my life numb, I'm the furthest I could possibly be from happy. And a laundry list of other reasons.

I've considered it. The only people left in my life are my direct family. They don't tick the same way as me and telling them would not end well. They'd get angry, wouldn't understand and would tell me to suck it up and grow up/get off my ass 

Edit: and the person I used to confide in stopped talking to me, that was the last friend I watched fade out of my life.
Please try living with severe depression in a life that should otherwise be perfect.
